metadata.methodology: Closed-loop HTTP/1.1 keep-alive; direct and proxy blocks alternate order. Non-streaming gateway latency is server request receipt through response serialization; overhead excludes timed upstream SDK calls, per request. Client latency includes complete body delivery. Streaming first content excludes non-content SSE events; streaming server timing is not collected.
